declarations.description:
A text input that fits what is typed to a pattern: postcodes, IBANs, tax IDs, card expiry dates, licence plates. The
`mask` names what each position accepts: `9` a digit, `a` a letter, `A` a letter in upper case, `*` a letter or digit
and `X` a letter or digit in upper case; any other character is a literal the field inserts itself (`\` escapes a mask
character, and `?` makes the rest of the mask optional, for values of varying length). `tokens` adds characters of
your own from script.

Characters a position does not accept are dropped, so typing, pasting a formatted or unformatted value and deleting
across a literal all work. While the field has focus or a value, the rest of the mask shows behind the text in
`slot-char`s, so the user sees what is left to type.

`value` holds the typed characters only (`FR7630006000011234567890189`), or the formatted text with
`include-literals`; the form submits the same. The element is form-associated (`name`) and validates like an input:
`required`, and an incomplete value is invalid. `complete` fires when the last required position is filled.

The host exposes its state as custom states: `:state(focus-within)`, `:state(complete)`, `:state(error)`,
`:state(disabled)` and `:state(read-only)`.

cssProperties.description: Space between the icons and the text.

slots.description: Icon or short adornment text at the start of the field.
slots.name: prefix-icon

members.name: mask
members.description:
The pattern: `9` digit, `a` letter, `A` upper-case letter, `*` letter or digit, `X` upper-case letter or digit,
`\` escapes the next character, `?` makes the rest optional. Anything else is a literal. Empty, the field takes any
text, like a plain input.

members.name: tokens
members.description: Mask characters of your own, added to (and winning over) the built-in ones.

members.name: value
members.description:
The typed characters, without the literals; with `include-literals`, the formatted text. Setting it fits the new
text to the mask. Setting the attribute after the user has typed no longer updates it, like a native input.

members.name: includeLiterals
members.description: `value` and the submitted form value include the mask's literals (`12/34` rather than `1234`).

members.name: slotChar
members.description: Character shown in the positions still to fill.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the value is submitted with the form under this name.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown while the field is empty and does not have focus.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the field. Defaults to the placeholder.

members.name: autocomplete
members.description: Autofill hint, e.g. `postal-code`, `cc-exp` or `tel-national`.

members.name: inputMode
members.description: Virtual keyboard to show. When unset, `numeric` for a mask of digits only, otherwise `text`.

members.name: required
members.description: The field must not be empty.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the field.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: The value can be selected and copied but not edited.

members.name: error
members.description: Marks the field invalid and shows `error-text` in place of `help`.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Message shown while `error` is set.

members.name: help
members.description: Helper text under the field.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: formattedValue
members.description: The value as displayed, literals included.

members.name: rawValue
members.description: The typed characters only, whatever `include-literals` says.

members.name: complete
members.description: Every required position of the mask is filled.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects the whole text.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets a custom validation message; an empty string clears it.

members.name: caretAt
members.description: Offset in the formatted text of the `index`-th typed character, or the end.

members.name: commit
members.description: Writes a new result to the inner input and the host, and puts the caret after `rawIndex` typed characters.

events.name: complete
events.description: The user filled the last required position of the mask.
Re-dispatched from the inner input after each edit; `value` is already updated.
events.name: input

events.description: Re-dispatched from the inner input when the value is committed (blur or Enter).
events.name: change
